title: Good idea but full of bugs - [Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress] Review | WordPress.org
text: Good idea but full of bugs - [Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress] Review | WordPress.org Skip to content Showcase Plugins Themes Hosting News Resources Learn WordPress Documentation Education Forums Developers Blocks Patterns Photos Openverse ↗ ︎ WordPress.tv ↗ ︎ About About WordPress Make WordPress Events Five for the Future Enterprise Gutenberg ↗ ︎ Job Board ↗ ︎ Swag ↗ ︎ Get WordPress Search in WordPress.org Get WordPress Forums Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Skip to content Forums / Plugin: Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress / Good idea but full of bugs Search for: Search forums Good idea but full of bugs localroadworthys (@localroadworthys) 1 year, 9 months ago The plugin implements some great ideas/features. But unfortunately it is full of bugs. Lots of things are not working or not working correctly. Really annoying. For example: It lets people book for appointments for times that are in the past. In my Business that means people book an appointment for a time that is already past, then blame me for not coming on-time. Like this, the plugin is not useable at all. I contacted the support, got 1 answer which was useless and never heard from the support again despite contacting them multiple times. I even set up a whole new website with a new Bookingpress system. Always the same problem. It allows bookings for times that are already past and also does not consider any buffer times. Strangely the problem only exists on some locations / services. On others it works fine. I tried everything but I can’t get it to work properly. No answers from the support. I guess I wasted my money and LOTS of time for an unusable product. The support is absolutely useless. On other problems before they blamed everyone and everything else but not their own product. I wish it would be working properly, then it would be a really great product. This topic was modified 1 year, 9 months ago by localroadworthys . Viewing 1 replies (of 1 total) Plugin Author reputeinfosystems (@reputeinfosystems) 1 year, 9 months ago Hi, Thank you for the feedback and giving complements on plugin features. Regarding plugin issues you claimed i think support staff had given you information and replied your ticket multiple times in last 2 days. There are no such issues present in plugin which you stated above and we tried to clear your confusion as well. Still let me clear here as well since you raised your concern here. 1. It is not possible for your customers to Book appointment in past date. If you felt so then it is probably because of timezone difference from your website time and device time from which you are making booking. System will work according to the time you stated on your WordPress website. We had shared you video as well. If you still believe there is an issue you can provide support staff some proof and way of how to regenerate the issue and they definitely fix any such issue immediately if present. 2. Also, you stated here that support staff is blaming others for their problems. I think that is also not true as there as our support staff is always committed to solve the issue and that is what they did, if something happened due to server configuration then unfortunately they have to point you in that direction in order to solve your problem and it does not mean it is blaming someone. From your review, i believe you still want to use BookingPress but just have some issues which you wanted to be addressed and we are more than happy to help but it make take few hours to reply due to timezone difference between our locations. Thanks Viewing 1 replies (of 1 total) The topic ‘Good idea but full of bugs’ is closed to new replies. title: Promising but ended up letting us down - [Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress] Review | WordPress.org
text: Promising but ended up letting us down - [Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress] Review | WordPress.org Skip to content Showcase Plugins Themes Hosting News Resources Learn WordPress Documentation Education Forums Developers Blocks Patterns Photos Openverse ↗ ︎ WordPress.tv ↗ ︎ About About WordPress Make WordPress Events Five for the Future Enterprise Gutenberg ↗ ︎ Job Board ↗ ︎ Swag ↗ ︎ Get WordPress Search in WordPress.org Get WordPress Forums Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Skip to content Forums / Plugin: Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress / Promising but ended up letting us down Search for: Search forums Promising but ended up letting us down zcomputers (@zcomputers) 2 years, 2 months ago After trialing countless booking systems, buying licenses for such, and then subsequently getting refunded when we discover they don’t fit the bill, we stumbled upon this plugin. It’s fantastic… Or so I initially thought. …That was until I spent several weeks battling with it ironing out countless bugs. The Calendar sync functionality is especially broken and only works in one direction, and overall the system proved to be massively unreliable. For example clicking on buttons to perform basic functions such as deleting appointments etc would always return errors and you would end up with redundant records of data stuck in the system which couldn’t be removed without deleting records from phpmyadmin. Support requests are dealt with very slowly and usually takes about 48 hours to respond, which isn’t really acceptable when you have just put a production site live and the entire thing falls apart. Plugin needs a lot of work to get it to a stable position. I would advise using alternatives until the devs can get this plugin to a more reliable state for use in production environments. This topic was modified 2 years, 2 months ago by zcomputers . So, i would suggest kindly continue communicating technical support and we are highly committed help you and fix all your issue with utmost priority. text: Dont buy this ! - [Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress] Review | WordPress.org Skip to content Showcase Plugins Themes Hosting News Resources Learn WordPress Documentation Education Forums Developers Blocks Patterns Photos Openverse ↗ ︎ WordPress.tv ↗ ︎ About About WordPress Make WordPress Events Five for the Future Enterprise Gutenberg ↗ ︎ Job Board ↗ ︎ Swag ↗ ︎ Get WordPress Search in WordPress.org Get WordPress Forums Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Skip to content Forums / Plugin: Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress / Dont buy this ! Search for: Search forums Dont buy this ! sixiemesens (@sixiemesens) 3 years, 2 months ago This plugin is a joke. On paper, it looks good, but nothing works properly. It’s full of bugs everywhere. You make tickets on the support, we answer you every 3-4 days, they have a Facebook group, if you complain about it, they delete the comments because you put your finger on the bugs publicly and they don’t like it. In addition, their comparison with [other plugins] is completely distorted, at Bookingpress you pay 99€ per year! With others you pay only once. I gave this plugin a chance for 4 months, I had a big bug that blocked my business for 5 days (my clients couldn’t make appointments at all), so I stopped expenses. The support is terrible, most of the time they don’t try to help you but say “need to update”, but the bug is still present, which proves that they haven’t even looked at your problem. .. It is shameful. Basically, there are bugs and you shouldn’t tell them or even expect a quick reaction from them. This topic was modified 3 years, 2 months ago by sixiemesens . Reason: Not the good stars choicing This topic was modified 3 years, 2 months ago by Steven Stern (sterndata) . Reason: removed name of other plugins Viewing 3 replies - 1 through 3 (of 3 total) Plugin Author reputeinfosystems (@reputeinfosystems) 3 years, 2 months ago Hello, sorry for the trouble you are facing. Regarding the plugin issue I believe its a premium version, the technical support staff is replying to you promptly. And not just every 3 days. Please share the truth here. And any issue. you may have will be fixed as soon as possible. Also, you paid $69 and not 99 EURO. so, kindly clear confusion. Also, if there is bug then we are always happy to help but If you want to place a comment on every member of the forum then that can affect them so, we can not allow that. Thread Starter sixiemesens (@sixiemesens) 3 years, 2 months ago Here are screenshots that prove what I’m saying here. A random ticket opened on July 29, first response from support on Tuesday August 1! (4 days later when no appointment was possible! ) And you can see i want to help you, i post responses from my analysis. Do you find it normal to have opened so many support tickets in 4 months? 10 support tickets. I use a dozen premium wordpress plugins and you are the only support so slow and so little invested! In addition, you do not put the dates and times of the answers… At least admit your mistakes and apologize for the problems instead of justifying yourself with false arguments. Regarding the price, it is indeed $69 the first year but then $99, your comparison with the competitors is therefore wrong because you are comparing with $69 and not $99, the other plugins you mention have a fixed price from the first year. I really tried to give the maximum chance to your plugin which has potential, but you do not assure the support and the fact of having deleted my comments on Facebook proves that you want to hide the “truth” instead of help when someone asks for help because their business is blocked. I’m really sorry, but by dint of writing support tickets and having little reaction, I made you react by posting a negative opinion. It’s a shame to come to this to get a dialogue. Moderator Support Moderator (@moderator) 3 years, 2 months ago Folks — this is a payment dispute and you should take this up privately. It’s not about other support tickets, either. I’m closing this topic. Viewing 3 replies - 1 through 3 (of 3 total) The topic ‘Dont buy this !’ is closed to new replies. title: Great for basic functions, but needs A LOT of dev work - [Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress] Review | WordPress.org
text: Great for basic functions, but needs A LOT of dev work - [Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress] Review | WordPress.org Skip to content Showcase Plugins Themes Hosting News Resources Learn WordPress Documentation Education Forums Developers Blocks Patterns Photos Openverse ↗ ︎ WordPress.tv ↗ ︎ About About WordPress Make WordPress Events Five for the Future Enterprise Gutenberg ↗ ︎ Job Board ↗ ︎ Swag ↗ ︎ Get WordPress Search in WordPress.org Get WordPress Forums Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Welcome to Support Guidelines Get involved Log in Skip to content Forums / Plugin: Appointment Booking Calendar Plugin and Scheduling Plugin – BookingPress / Great for basic functions, but needs A LOT of dev work Search for: Search forums Great for basic functions, but needs A LOT of dev work nomadlifejapan (@nomadlifejapan) 2 years, 1 month ago I thought I had found the best booking plugin after trying out several of other popular options. It seems great but the more you customize the settings to your needs, the more your realize how many issues or incomplete functions there are. For example, the stripe integration addon is horrible. It looks like the devs gave up and just put together something that kind of works. The payment popup looks very SHADY. Looks nothing like the official stripe payment page. It also cannot be dismissed so you’re stuck in the payment process once the popup is on screen. Zero-decimal currencies like JPY or KRW are multiplied by 100, so you end up charging huge amounts (100x) for services. Other issues: staff holidays are not viewable on the calendar dashboard no option to set partial refund within X days, but full refund outside this (must set a minimum fee that cannot be refunded if the partial refund feature is enabled) custom duration settings don’t make sense. you cannot set price per unit for certain unit amounts (price per hour for 4 hour bookings, for example). instead you have to manually set different packages for each number of hours. taxes and coupons amounts are not calculated properly And a bunch of other inconveniences. All in all a very disappointing experience and a waste of time for my clients. Viewing 3 replies - 1 through 3 (of 3 total) Plugin Support dimplemodi (@dimplemodi) 2 years, 1 month ago Hello @nomadlifejapan , It’s very sad to know that you’re disappointed with the BookingPress. I’ve checked all the points you have mentioned and it seems that they are related to the premium version of the BookingPress. Your review is acceptable at wordpress.org but for technical help regarding the premium version, we already have a dedicated support team for the paid version, I would highly recommend you open a support ticket there and our team will assist you in resolving your concerns as soon as possible. However, you have raised the issue publicly, let me assist you with basic information. Regarding Stripe popup close button, it’s prevented by Stripe itself. And everything is accordingly to Stripe standard and if you still not happy, please give your suggestion to our idea board. Regarding currency issue, it’s already been fixed and update will be coming out soon. Regarding staff holidays displays in calendar, please give your suggestion to our idea board. Regarding custom duration, to set price per unit is already there, so please contact us from our official support for more assistance. Regarding taxes and coupons, everything is working fine. so please contact us from our official support for more assistance. Thanks Thread Starter nomadlifejapan (@nomadlifejapan) 2 years, 1 month ago Thank you for responding. I did get help for some technical issues but most of the features I asked about I was told to request a feature, as you also say. There’s too many poorly implemented or incomplete functions, even for functions not related to the premium version. I am not looking to do your dev work by listing every single bug or feature improvement. Keep up your work and maybe in 2-3 years time the quality of the plugin will improve. For now I will move on to a different plugin that suits my needs better. In its current state, I find your (premium) plugin unusable for clients that demand a great quality booking system. Cheers! Plugin Author reputeinfosystems (@reputeinfosystems) 2 years, 1 month ago Hi, If you are asking about feature then and if it is not there then best way to get it is sharing your thought so that if more people are interested then we can add that feature on priority basis. And that is the reason BookingPress is been loved by couple of thousand people as it is built through request of lots of users. But, unfortunately you are not one of those happy users, I highly appreciate that you shared your problems. We genuinely encourage you to share your other issues too if you have, i am not asking you to do the developer job or work of a tester. But if you share your past experienced issues in details then we get to know if its bug then it will be solved immediately and you are doing favor to other users too. And if it is not bug then we get chance to explain and clear confusion so if anybody else read this then they get some help. Thank you very much for trying BookingPress. This reply was modified 2 years, 1 month ago by reputeinfosystems .
